issue.summary: {Break 4.4} Formatting in codeblock not retained correctly
issue.description: When content is pasted into a codeblock, its source formatting and manually added spaces are not retained after save and reopen.

issue.summary: Spaces Removed in Codeblock When Toggling Editor Views
issue.description: When content moves from Source Editor to Author Editor and back, spaces around inline elements are removed. Spaces should remain as authored.

issue.summary: The status indicator should display Ready after a successful save.
issue.description: Expected behavior: The status indicator is present and displays Ready after a successful save and refresh. The same specification-defined result is shown when the feature is enabled. A disabled feature or failure must not display Ready. The behavior remains backward compatible after upgrade across supported versions and Cloud and on-prem deployments.
